title: How I WON the Pokemon World Championships
author: Andrew Hedrick
credentials: 2026 Pokémon TCG World Champion (Masters); winner LA Regionals 2026 with Crushing Hammer Dragapult
deck_version: his own Worlds 2026 list (identical by name/count to corpus/decks/hedrick_worlds_2026.json)
value: The only Tier-1 primary source retrieved in which the champion explains his own decisions, including two he judges as mistakes. Several board states are described precisely enough to reconstruct.
limits: Auto-generated captions with many name errors; board states are described, not always fully specified; self-review of his own games (no independent reviewer).

title: These GENIUS Plays Won Andrew Hedrick The Pokémon World Championships! - Pro Player Analysis
author: Ciaran Farah
credentials: competitive player/analyst; credentials not verified from an official source in this pass
type: video (13 min), third-party analysis of the Worlds final

limits: One analyst's opinion, not a consensus; he reconstructs the boards himself and says his recreation may not be exact.
